name: squeeze_floor_zero_is_legacy_passthrough
description: AC-1 edge: squeeze_floor=0.0 is treated as 'no clamp' (the <=0 escape hatch), NOT as a floor of 0 (which would be a no-op anyway) and NOT rejected. Byte-identical legacy squeezed value.
derivation: pre_squeeze=0.30. active=0.30*0.5=0.15. squeeze_floor=0.0 -> the `squeeze_floor > 0` guard is False -> no clamp. Output 0.15 (unchanged).
